### Upstream Changes

**`src/macos/liquid_glass.rs`** — adds `interactive: Option<bool>` to `LiquidGlassOptions` and a conditionally dispatched `glass_view.setEffectIsInteractive(interactive)` call inside `apply_liquid_glass()`. Unreachable from the app's call site.

**`src/macos/ns_glass_effect_view_tagged.rs`** — adds `supportsEffectIsInteractive()` via `respondsToSelector(sel!(setEffectIsInteractive:))`, plus getter `effectIsInteractive()` and setter `setEffectIsInteractive()`, both guarded by that check. The getter relies on the assumption that setter and getter are introduced together as a paired `@property`; no independent SDK introduction proof or macOS 26/27 runtime test was supplied. The guard prevents the message send if the selector is absent; correctness of the getter guard on older systems depends on the paired-property assumption holding, which is architecturally standard but not independently verified here. The app does not call this path.

**`src/macos/vibrancy.rs`** — confirmed UNCHANGED in archive evidence. This is the app's actual code path.

**`windows-sys` range** — widened from `0.60.0` to `>=0.60, <=0.61`; lock resolves `windows-sys 0.60.2`, unchanged. `src/windows.rs` confirmed UNCHANGED.
